utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the plan for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re meeting Thursday evening, and we’re doing the first half of the book so everyone can catch up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thursday evening works for me. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I can bring the folding chairs for book club if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. That helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting at Mara’s place this week, and they’re picking something a little lighter for once.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nicer, but I hope the timing works out for everyone. I should probably check whether there’s enough seating before I go.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d ask Mara if she can squeeze in a couple extra chairs, just in case. That way nobody has to balance a mug on their knee.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the book club. What are you reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re reading *The Midnight Library* this week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s a great pick. I’ve heard it gives people a lot to talk about.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come to book club with me this week - I think you'd enjoy it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe. Thanks for asking.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Come on, it’ll be fun. If you can make it, I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the book club list ready, and I can help you sort out the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, what time works for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Next Saturday at 3 works well for me. Would that fit your schedule?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard the details yet. What day is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It’s on Thursday evening, if I remember right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, what time on Thursday evening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do book club after I get the kids settled; what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: How about 7:30 at my place? If that’s too tight after the kids are settled, I can do 8.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8 works better for me after the kids are settled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club might be meeting at Maya’s place this week. Is that still the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I think that’s still the plan unless Maya says otherwise. I can check with her and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, just let me know what Maya says.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the book club - what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, we’re still on for 7, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’ve been meaning to ask how it’s been going.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it’s been good overall, though I keep forgetting which book we’re on. I think everyone’s enjoying it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s nice to hear. I should stop by and help keep track of the next one sometime.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I’m in for book club. I’ll tell everyone the plan and see who’s bringing snacks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring the list and figure out snacks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll let everyone know the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club picked a new novel, and I’m curious what everyone thinks of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’d be interested to know what made them pick it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Maybe they chose it because it has something to say, and I’m hoping the discussion gets lively once folks start reading it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think we were talking about the next meeting, but I may have mixed up the day.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think it was next Tuesday, unless I’m mixing it up too. I can check and make sure we’ve got the right day.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, that would help — I always get the days mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club. I think I saw something about it, but I might’ve missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I haven’t seen the latest update either. I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, let me know what you find. I probably missed it too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring over a chair if the book club needs one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help, Gus. I’ll keep it simple and have the chair ready at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll swing by with it at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad to help with book club. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s a mystery pick this month, but I’ll text the details and get you on the invite list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, just text me the details when you have them and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'd love to hear which book they're reading this month - it sounds like a good one to bring neighbors together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely. I can see why the book club would be a nice way to bring everyone together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo. I’ll bring the book club list and see what everyone wants to read next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, that helps. I’ll see if I need anything from the list too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, I’ll bring the list and make sure we’ve got a solid next read.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club might be meeting at Mina’s place, but I’m not sure if that’s still right.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t think so anymore, unless someone else already offered their place. I’ll confirm where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, let me know once you hear back so I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the book club? Yeah, I can make that—just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks. I’ll send you the time and place once I’ve sorted it out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club. What are we reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Which book are we reading this month, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think it’s the one by Mina Patel this time. I can double-check the title if you want.
